say:0:1321602001:0.text: Magister, Chippy hears a child crying up ahead! Let's go see what's going on!
say:0:1321602001:0.source_cn: 主人，前面有小孩的哭声！过去看看出了什么事吧。
say:0:1321602001:0.male: Magister, Chippy hears a child crying up ahead! Let's go see what's going on!
say:0:1321602001:0.female: Magister, Chippy hears a child crying up ahead! Let's go see what's going on!

say:1:1321603001:0.text: Hey, don't be so harsh! The poor girl's already in tears!
say:1:1321603001:0.source_cn: 这位大叔，没必要这么凶巴巴的吧？这个小姑娘都哭了！

say:2:1321603002:1.text: You don't understand! She snuck into these ruins all by herself without a word. I was worried sick!
say:2:1321603002:1.source_cn: 你懂什么！她居然一声不吭地独自跑到这片废墟里，不教训怎么成！

say:3:1321603003:1.text: Lorna, I told you this isn't a place for kids to play hide and seek! Those undead can crawl out of the ground at any moment. Coming here alone is just asking for trouble!
say:3:1321603003:1.source_cn: 亚娜，我和你说了多少遍了，这片废墟很危险，时不时就会从...

say:5:1321603004:0.text: *Sobbing* I-I'm sorry, Grandpa. I just wanted to pick some fruit for you...
say:5:1321603004:0.source_cn: 呜呜呜……对不起，爷爷……我只是想摘一些果子给你……

say:6:1321603005:0.text: Lorna, listen to me... If I wanted the fruit, I'd go get it myself. I wouldn't want anything bad to happen to you, you hear me?
say:6:1321603005:0.source_cn: ……你听我说，小亚娜。我要是想吃果子，早就自己去摘了，...

say:7:1321603006:0.text: I know the fruit here is big and sweet, but do you know why no one ever comes here? Because there are always undead roaming around!
say:7:1321603006:0.source_cn: 爷爷知道这里的果子又大又甜，但为什么没人来摘？不就是因...

say:8:1321603007:0.text: If I hadn't followed you, what would you have done about the ones chasing you?
say:8:1321603007:0.source_cn: 今天要不是我跟了过来，你准备拿刚才那些追你的活死人怎么办？

say:9:1321603008:0.text: You're lucky they weren't too close and that you're quick. If not, I might've lost you forever!
say:9:1321603008:0.source_cn: 要不是你运气好，离他们不算太近，跑得也快，恐怕爷爷就再...

say:10:1321603009:1.text: I-I'm really sorry... I promise you I won't come here again...
say:10:1321603009:1.source_cn: 对、对不起，亚娜知道错了……

say:12:1321603010:0.text: Well, considering what happened, a scolding seems fair enough...
say:12:1321603010:0.source_cn: 居然发生了这么危险的事……看来教训几句也是应该的。

say:13:1321603011:1.text: Alright, I've said enough. Let's head home.
say:13:1321603011:1.source_cn: 呼……行了，训也训够了，咱们还是早点回去吧。

say:14:1321603012:0.text: No... no... I can't go back now...
say:14:1321603012:0.source_cn: 不……呜呜呜……不行，亚娜不能回去……

say:16:1321603013:0.text: What? Don't be ridiculous! Is there something about these fruits that's drawing you in like this?!
say:16:1321603013:0.source_cn: 为什么？难道这里的果子藏着什么秘密，吸引力才这么大？！

say:17:1321603014:1.text: N-no... There was a strange guy... who helped me escape...
say:17:1321603014:1.source_cn: 不、不是……刚才，有个怪……怪人……帮了亚娜……

choice_prompt:18:1321603014.text: N-no... There was a strange guy... who helped me escape...
choice_prompt:18:1321603014.source_cn: 不、不是……刚才，有个怪……怪人……帮了亚娜……

say:20:1321603016:0.text: He stopped those undead... and told me to run quickly. That's why I was able to escape!
say:20:1321603016:0.source_cn: 他、他拦住了那些，活死人……还让亚娜赶快跑！所以，亚娜...
say:20:1321603016:0.male: He stopped those undead... and told me to run quickly. That's why I was able to escape!
say:20:1321603016:0.female: He stopped those undead... and told me to run quickly. That's why I was able to escape!

say:22:1321603019:1.text: Don't worry. If he helped you, it means he's probably strong enough to deal with those undead.
say:22:1321603019:1.source_cn: ……别担心，小亚娜。既然他肯帮你，就说明他或许有能力对...

say:23:1321603020:0.text: *Sniff* But I'm still scared... It's all my fault, I led the undead there...
say:23:1321603020:0.source_cn: 可、可是，我还是担心……都怪我，引来了活死人……呜……

choice_prompt:24:1321603020.text: *Sniff* But I'm still scared... It's all my fault, I led the undead there...
choice_prompt:24:1321603020.source_cn: 可、可是，我还是担心……都怪我，引来了活死人……呜……

say:26:1321603022:1.text: Lorna, do you remember where you last saw that strange guy?
say:26:1321603022:1.source_cn: 亚娜，你还记得是在哪遇见那位怪人的吗？

say:27:1321603023:1.text: Hmm... It was <style="highlight">in the ruins</style>... <style="highlight">near the river</style>.

say:28:1321603024:0.text: The undead and that guy both showed up there!
say:28:1321603024:0.source_cn: 活死人，还有怪人，都是从那里出现的……！

say:29:1321603025:0.text: Let's go, Magister. We might find some clues over there!
say:29:1321603025:0.source_cn: 主人，我们去那附近找找看吧，肯定能找到一些痕迹！
say:29:1321603025:0.male: Let's go, Magister. We might find some clues over there!
say:29:1321603025:0.female: Let's go, Magister. We might find some clues over there!

choice:24:0:1.text: Don't worry, we'll go take a look.
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 别担心，我们去帮你看看
choice:24:0:1.male: Don't worry, we'll go take a look.
choice:24:0:1.female: Don't worry, we'll go take a look.

say:31:1321603021:0.text: Hmm... Maybe we can go check on the guy who saved her and see if he's okay.
say:31:1321603021:0.source_cn: 呃……要是我们帮她确认一下那位怪人的安危，应该可以吧？
say:31:1321603021:0.male: Hmm... Maybe we can go check on the guy who saved her and see if he's okay.
say:31:1321603021:0.female: Hmm... Maybe we can go check on the guy who saved her and see if he's okay.

choice_prompt:32:1321603021.text: Hmm... Maybe we can go check on the guy who saved her and see if he's okay.
choice_prompt:32:1321603021.source_cn: 呃……要是我们帮她确认一下那位怪人的安危，应该可以吧？
choice_prompt:32:1321603021.male: Hmm... Maybe we can go check on the guy who saved her and see if he's okay.
choice_prompt:32:1321603021.female: Hmm... Maybe we can go check on the guy who saved her and see if he's okay.

choice:24:1:2.text: How do we stop her from crying...?
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 有没有办法让她别再哭了……
choice:24:1:2.male: How do we stop her from crying...?
choice:24:1:2.female: How do we stop her from crying...?

say:33:1321603017:0.text: He stopped those undead... and told me to run quickly.
say:33:1321603017:0.source_cn: 他——他帮亚娜，拦住了活死人！而且一直说……让亚娜快跑！
say:33:1321603017:0.male: He stopped those undead... and told me to run quickly.
say:33:1321603017:0.female: He stopped those undead... and told me to run quickly.

say:0:1321604001:0.text: There are footprints here—Lorna must've left them while running.
say:0:1321604001:0.source_cn: 这里有脚印，看起来像是亚娜逃跑时留下的。

say:1:1321604002:0.text: If we trace these footprints, we might be able to find that guy!
say:1:1321604002:0.source_cn: 那只要反着走，应该就能找到那位怪人了！

say:0:1321605001:0.text: Chippy sees Lorna's footprints here too. She's really got guts, coming out to a place like this...
say:0:1321605001:0.source_cn: 这里也有亚娜的脚印。她的胆子还真大，都跑到这种地方来了……

say:1:1321606001:0.text: This is unbelievable... The guy who saved Lorna was actually a spirit!
say:1:1321606001:0.source_cn: 没想到……亚娜遇见的怪人居然是个幽灵……！

say:2:1321606002:1.text: Thankfully, he doesn't seem hostile towards humans.
say:2:1321606002:1.source_cn: 幸好，他看起来对人类没有敌意。

say:5:1321606004:0.text: Leave quickly... children... this is no place to play...
say:5:1321606004:0.source_cn: 快离开……孩子们……这里不是，玩耍的地方……

choice_prompt:6:1321606004.text: Leave quickly... children... this is no place to play...
choice_prompt:6:1321606004.source_cn: 快离开……孩子们……这里不是，玩耍的地方……

say:7:1321606005:0.text: Huh?! Do we look like children?!
say:7:1321606005:0.source_cn: 哎？！我们看起来很像小孩吗？

say:8:1321606006:1.text: Many lost children end up here...
say:8:1321606006:1.source_cn: 迷路的孩子，好多……经常有……
say:8:1321606006:1.male: Many lost children end up here...
say:8:1321606006:1.female: Many lost children end up here...

say:9:1321606007:0.text: With undead all around, adults know to stay away... Only children accidentally wander into this place.
say:9:1321606007:0.source_cn: 到处都是活死人……大人，不会来……只有小孩……
say:9:1321606007:0.male: With undead all around, adults know to stay away... Only children accidentally wander into this place.
say:9:1321606007:0.female: With undead all around, adults know to stay away... Only children accidentally wander into this place.

choice_prompt:10:1321606007.text: With undead all around, adults know to stay away... Only children accidentally wander into this place.
choice_prompt:10:1321606007.source_cn: 到处都是活死人……大人，不会来……只有小孩……
choice_prompt:10:1321606007.male: With undead all around, adults know to stay away... Only children accidentally wander into this place.
choice_prompt:10:1321606007.female: With undead all around, adults know to stay away... Only children accidentally wander into this place.

say:11:1321606008:0.text: Why am I here...? How did I get here...?
say:11:1321606008:0.male: Why am I here...? How did I get here...?
say:11:1321606008:0.female: Why am I here...? How did I get here...?

say:13:1321606010:0.text: Magister, he seems young, but he's just really tall!
say:13:1321606010:0.source_cn: 主人，仔细一看，这个幽灵的年纪好像也不是很大，只是个子...
say:13:1321606010:0.male: Magister, he seems young, but he's just really tall!
say:13:1321606010:0.female: Magister, he seems young, but he's just really tall!

say:14:1321606011:1.text: Could he have gotten lost here, too? And then...
say:14:1321606011:1.source_cn: 难不成，他也是因为迷路来到这里的？最后又……

say:15:1321606012:1.text: You're not children... You're adults, so you must know the way...
say:15:1321606012:1.source_cn: 你们，不是小孩……是大人，认得路……

say:16:1321606013:0.text: Can you please lead me home?
say:16:1321606013:0.source_cn: 所以……你们可以，带我回家……对不对？

say:17:1321606014:0.source_cn: ——等一下，怎么又扯到带你回家的事了？！

say:18:1321606015:1.text: Where do you live? Hold on, we don't even know your name yet.
say:18:1321606015:1.source_cn: 你的家在哪？对了，我们还不知道你的名字呢。

say:20:1321606017:0.text: I don't remember where my home is... but my mother is there. I need to find her...
say:20:1321606017:0.source_cn: 我的家在……我不知道在哪……但是母亲在那里，我要去找母亲……

say:21:1321606018:0.text: Hmm, it's going to be tricky if you've forgotten where your home is...
say:21:1321606018:0.source_cn: 唔，忘记家在哪就难办了……

say:22:1321606019:0.text: Can you remember roughly where it is? Or maybe some landmarks? A place like home should leave some kind of impression.
say:22:1321606019:0.source_cn: 大概的位置你还能想起来吗？或者……记忆比较深刻的地方也...

say:23:1321606020:1.text: Umm... <style="highlight">the lake in the south</style> froze and cracked with a big hole in it... and... there are wild fruits in <style="highlight">the ruins on the cliffs</style> to the north...

say:24:1321606021:1.text: How strange, the two places he remembers are in completely opposite directions.
say:24:1321606021:1.source_cn: 真奇怪，他印象深刻的两个地方刚好方向相反呢。

say:25:1321606022:0.text: Let's head out and check anyway. Maybe his home is near one of those places!
say:25:1321606022:0.source_cn: 算了，我们还是先过去看看吧！说不定他家就在这两个地方附近！

choice:6:0:1.text: He must be talking about you two.
choice:6:0:1.male: He must be talking about you two.
choice:6:0:1.female: He must be talking about you two.

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我怎么看也不像小孩吧？

say:1:1321607001:0.text: There's a hole in the ice here. Could this be the place Dominique mentioned?
say:1:1321607001:0.source_cn: 这里的冰面上就有一个洞，会不会是德米记忆中的地方呢？

say:2:1321607002:1.text: But... Chippy doesn't see any houses around.
say:2:1321607002:1.source_cn: 可是，这附近好像没有房子啊？

say:4:1321607003:1.text: The river water was cold... I remember now...

say:5:1321607004:0.text: Thalia and I came here to play... The ice cracked, and I fell into the water... I could hardly hear Thalia's cries... Luckily, someone passed by and saved me...
say:5:1321607004:0.source_cn: 我和佐娅，一起来这里玩……冰面碎了大洞，我掉进水里……...

say:6:1321607005:0.text: Mother didn't let us come back here again after that...
say:6:1321607005:0.source_cn: 后来……母亲不允许，我和佐娅再来这里……

say:8:1321607007:1.source_cn: 是……我的妹妹……可爱的佐娅……

choice_prompt:9:1321607007.source_cn: 是……我的妹妹……可爱的佐娅……

say:10:1321607008:0.text: This isn't where my home is...
say:10:1321607008:0.male: This isn't where my home is...
say:10:1321607008:0.female: This isn't where my home is...

choice:9:0:1.text: No wonder you remember this place.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 难怪你对这里印象深刻
choice:9:0:1.male: No wonder you remember this place.
choice:9:0:1.female: No wonder you remember this place.

say:1:1321608001:1.source_cn: 这片废墟……还有……黄色的野果……？！

say:3:1321608002:1.source_cn: 德米，你是想起点什么了吗？

say:5:1321608003:1.text: These are <style="highlight">amberfruits</style>... They're my mother's favorite.

say:6:1321608004:1.text: My sister found them here... and we gave them to Mother.
say:6:1321608004:1.source_cn: 我的妹妹，在这里……找到了它……送给母亲……

say:7:1321608005:1.text: I knew she loved them, but she never admitted it because she was worried about the dangers of us coming here...
say:7:1321608005:1.source_cn: 母亲喜欢……但是担心我们，这里很危险……所以，她一直说...

say:10:1321608007:1.text: That's why this place was so special to you... You and your sister must have visited here often.
say:10:1321608007:1.source_cn: 原来是这样啊。你和你妹妹以前应该经常过来，所以才会一直...

say:11:1321608008:1.text: Well if that's the case, your home likely isn't nearby.
say:11:1321608008:1.source_cn: 不过这样说来，你家也不可能在这附近了。

say:1:1321609001:0.text: Dominique, neither of the places you talked about is your home.
say:1:1321609001:0.source_cn: 德米，你说的两个地方都不是你家。

say:4:1321609003:0.text: These two places seem more like spots where you and your sister went on secret adventures. You've told us several times that it was dangerous here, with undead roaming about.
say:4:1321609003:0.source_cn: 是啊。比起你家，这里更像是你和你妹妹偷偷跑出来冒险的地...

say:5:1321609004:0.text: Usually, people live near Cedartown. Does this name ring a bell to you?
say:5:1321609004:0.source_cn: 一般来说，民居应该都是雪松镇附近。你对雪松镇有没有印象？

say:6:1321609005:1.text:
Cedartown...
Yes... Yes, I remember Cedartown. The square was usually full of people...
say:6:1321609005:1.source_cn: 雪松镇……\n我……记得名字，记得……广场上，很多人……

say:7:1321609006:0.text: Hmm, asking like this probably won't help much... Let's head to <style="highlight">Cedartown</style>! Maybe once we're there, Dominique will remember more.
say:7:1321609006:0.source_cn: 唔，光是这样问也问不出来什么……还是去一趟<style...

say:1:1321610001:0.text: This forest... and the houses up ahead...
say:1:1321610001:0.source_cn: 这片树林……前面的房子……好熟悉……

say:2:1321610002:0.text: Great! Are you starting to remember something?
say:2:1321610002:0.source_cn: 太好了！你是不是想起了点什么？

say:3:1321610003:1.text: No... I can't let anyone see me like this...
say:3:1321610003:1.source_cn: 镇子……雪松镇。不能让大家……看到我……

say:5:1321610004:1.text: Are you worried you'll scare people?

choice_prompt:6:1321610004.text: Are you worried you'll scare people?

say:7:1321610005:1.text: Hmmm... How about we stay here <style="highlight">until it gets dark</style> to avoid scaring anyone?

choice:6:1:2.text: A spirit can scare people away.
choice:6:1:2.male: A spirit can scare people away.
choice:6:1:2.female: A spirit can scare people away.

say:0:1321611001:0.text: It's finally dark. Let's take Dominique into the town now.
say:0:1321611001:0.source_cn: 天总算黑了。我们现在就带着德米进入镇子吧。

say:0:1321612001:0.text: I used to play in the square with Thalia all the time...
say:0:1321612001:0.source_cn: 广场……我经常和佐娅一起，来广场上玩……

say:1:1321612002:0.text: The path to the north... seems so familiar.

say:1:1321613001:1.text: This is it! This is where I lived!
say:1:1321613001:1.source_cn: 这里……是这里！我的家在这里……

say:3:1321613002:0.text: Are you sure?! Which house is yours?!

say:4:1321613003:1.text: Wait... my house isn't here anymore... I don't see my house...
say:4:1321613003:1.source_cn: 没有……没有我家的房子了……

say:5:1321613004:0.text: How long has it been since I left home? Mother, Father, Thalia... where are you?
say:5:1321613004:0.source_cn: 我……我离开家，究竟多久了……母亲，父亲，佐娅……

say:8:1321613006:1.text:
I hear a familiar voice...
Someone is calling to me!
say:8:1321613006:1.source_cn: ……有声音，熟悉的声音。\n有人在呼唤我……！

say:11:1321613008:1.text: Wait—! You're a spirit now, you can't just rush into a temple like that!
say:11:1321613008:1.source_cn: 等等——！你现在是幽灵啊，怎么能跑去教堂——？！

say:0:1321614001:0.text: Quick, follow him! We can't let him get into the temple!
say:0:1321614001:0.source_cn: 快跟上去吧！千万不能让他跑进教堂！

say:1:1321616001:0.source_cn: 这……这不是克谢尼娅大婶的墓吗？！

say:2:1321616002:1.text: I remember Ksenia had a son and a daughter. Her son died at the hands of the undead while trying to protect his sister...
say:2:1321616002:1.source_cn: 我记得，克谢尼娅大婶有一对儿女，也是哥哥和妹妹。而且她...

say:3:1321616003:0.text: And the place we met Dominique is often haunted by the undead...
say:3:1321616003:0.source_cn: 而我们遇到德米的地方，经常有活死人出没……

choice_prompt:4:1321616003.text: And the place we met Dominique is often haunted by the undead...
choice_prompt:4:1321616003.source_cn: 而我们遇到德米的地方，经常有活死人出没……

say:6:1321616004:1.text: That's right... Ksenia was my mother...
say:6:1321616004:1.source_cn: 是的……我母亲的名字……克谢尼娅……
say:6:1321616004:1.male: That's right... Ksenia was my mother...
say:6:1321616004:1.female: That's right... Ksenia was my mother...

say:7:1321616005:0.text: Thalia and I couldn't afford a gift for Mother's birthday, so we picked amberfruits for her instead...
say:7:1321616005:0.source_cn: 母亲的生日……我和佐娅，买不起礼物……只能去采雾澄果……

say:8:1321616006:0.text: Then you encountered the undead... To protect Thalia, you stayed behind to hold them off and ended up like this...
say:8:1321616006:0.source_cn: ……然后，你们就遇到了活死人。为了保护妹妹佐娅，你选择...

say:9:1321616007:0.text: Is that what happened...? I don't remember anything...

say:10:1321616008:1.text: That's what your mother told us.
say:10:1321616008:1.source_cn: 这些是你母亲告诉我们的。

say:11:1321616009:0.text: Perhaps what happened to you before you died left you with a strong sense of duty. Every time you see a child being chased by the undead, you rush to their defense without a second thought...
